steps.name: the status page and its JSON read from the store
the one-minute cron runs a probe pass into the object
steps.note: It asserts a healthy origin. The local scenario serves one on 127.0.0.1, which a pool can't reach, so the origin here is a host that never answers

steps.name: three failing passes open an incident, and the page shows it
the open incident survives the object's sleep
steps.note: Waited 30 s idle with no socket open, and the cron wakes this object each minute. Sleep itself is not proven on a pool.

steps.name: the open incident survives a restart
after the restart, the cron runs again, and two good passes resolve the incident
steps.note: It needs an origin that recovers, which a pool can't reach

steps.name: an operator alert email goes out through the Cloudflare Email API
